note: Derived reading aid. Never authoritative; never read as intent (Decision 0004). The Plan document governs.
author: Lightweight model draft for Clara (technical writing) via Claudia Atlas <claudia.atlas@agents.arcadia.local>
title: Make every operator screen fast on a phone
purpose: Every operator interaction should be quick on a phone and update itself, so the operator never waits on a page or searches for something. Decisions and runs should each have their own page, and Ask results should show what Arcadia heard and created.
serves: The Project outcome of the operator giving input and seeing results quickly, without holding the portfolio in mind.
done_when: Each decision and each run opens on its own page that updates without a reload, and an Ask shows what it heard and what it created on the same screen.
reading_note: Draft: none of the 9 Actions has started.

actions.title: Load decisions on the runs page only when opened
actions.why: A runs page that loads every decision up front is slow on a phone.
actions.done_when: The runs page renders without loading any decisions, and opening the decisions area loads them on demand.

actions.title: Give each decision its own quick-loading page
actions.why: A decision read on its own loads faster and is easier to answer on a phone.
actions.done_when: Each decision has a stable address showing only that decision, and its state updates after an answer without a reload.

actions.title: Give each run its own quick-loading page
actions.why: A run read on its own shows its progress without the rest of the list.
actions.done_when: Each run has a stable address showing only that run, and its state changes appear without a reload.

actions.title: Send Discord notices to channels by purpose
actions.why: Separate channels let the operator tell at a glance which kind of notice arrived.
actions.done_when: Each notice type posts to its own configured channel, and a receipt reads as queued until it is sent.

actions.title: Audit every operator screen for phone speed and clarity
actions.why: A single review of every screen shows which parts are slow or unclear.
actions.done_when: Every operator page, button and notice is timed or reviewed at phone width, and each finding is filed as a tracked Action or Issue.

actions.title: Label unclear session states with a one-line diagnosis
actions.why: A short label helps the operator understand a stalled session without reading its log.
actions.done_when: The local model labels only states the simple classifier could not label, with one label from a fixed set and a reason, and its output never changes Action state.

actions.title: Show what an Ask heard and let the operator correct it in one tap
actions.why: An unmatched request should be correctable at the moment it is captured, not found later.
actions.done_when: The Ask result shows what was heard before any other detail, and a menu offers the correction types, each re-routing the request.

actions.title: Show what an Ask created, or that nothing was created
actions.why: The operator needs evidence that an Ask became prioritized work, or a plain statement that it did not.
actions.done_when: The Ask screen lists each Action, decision or back-burner item the request produced with its project, plan and queue position, or says plainly that nothing was created.

actions.title: Draw a map of a just-submitted Ask and its connections
actions.why: A map shows the Ask in its context and helps the operator judge the routing, but it is secondary to the correction menu.
actions.done_when: A short comparison of two drawing approaches names the one chosen, the map appears right after submit from fixed data, and a slow or empty map does not block the correction menu.
